'''Blunt''' was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|cold assault trooper]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
"Blunt" was the nickname of one of the numerous [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] that were created to serve the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war, Blunt served under the command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sharp]] in the [[Devil Dogs]], a unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[44th Special Operations Division]] that specialized in "explosive" missions.<ref name="ISotR 2" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|engagement]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] for control over the valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] ore, Blunt was killed after his unit and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] were ambushed by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and her [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]].<ref name="ISotR 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blunt was created by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]] for the [[The Clone Wars 8|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic|''In Service of the Republic'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]]. He was drawn in the issue by [[Scott Hepburn]].
